feedback.problem:
Negate the following statement:

$\,$ There exists $x\in Z$ such that $x<4.$
feedback.worked_solution:
If we denote

$$
P(x):x<4,
$$

our statement can be written as

$$
∃x\in Z,\,P(x).
$$

Negating this, we obtain

$$
¬(∃x\in Z,\,P(x))≡∀x\in Z,\,¬P(x).
$$

Finally, $∀x\in Z,\,¬P(x)$ reads as follows:

$\,$ **For all** $x\in Z,$ $x\ge 4.$
